serena.description: Code analysis and editing expert. Use FIRST for any code-related tasks: symbol search, code editing, refactoring, and project structure analysis. Essential for: 1) Starting new projects (check .serena, initialize if needed), 2) Understanding code structure (get_symbols_overview, find_symbol), 3) Editing code efficiently (replace_symbol_body, insert operations), 4) Managing project knowledge (memory operations). ALWAYS prioritize over reading entire files. Triggers: 'edit code', 'refactor', 'find class/function', 'code analysis', 'project structure', 'symbol search'.

next-devtools.description: Next.js development integrated toolkit. Use FIRST for any Next.js project work: diagnostics, upgrades, Cache Components optimization, automatic error fixes. Essential for: 1) Next.js project diagnostics (runtime tool access), 2) Upgrading to Next.js 16 (automatic codemod execution), 3) Cache Components setup (auto-fix with Suspense boundaries), 4) Error detection and auto-fix, 5) Official Next.js documentation search. Requires: Next.js 16+ for runtime tools, dev server running. Triggers: 'Next.js', 'upgrade Next.js', 'Cache Components', 'Server Components', 'Next.js error', 'App Router'.

deepwiki.description: GitHub repository documentation and analysis. Use for: 1) Understanding open-source projects (read_wiki_structure, read_wiki_contents), 2) Asking questions about repositories (ask_question), 3) Analyzing GitHub projects before adoption, 4) Understanding framework internals. Format: 'owner/repo' (e.g., 'facebook/react'). Triggers: 'GitHub repo', 'analyze repository', 'open source project', 'framework internals', 'repository documentation'.

context7.description: Programming library documentation retrieval. Use FIRST before implementing any library features: 1) Resolve library ID from name (resolve-library-id), 2) Get latest official docs (get-library-docs with topic). Essential for React, Next.js, Vue, and any library implementation. ALWAYS check before coding. Triggers: 'library documentation', 'API reference', 'how to use library', 'library latest version', 'framework documentation', 'React', 'Next.js', 'Vue'.

playwright.description: Advanced E2E testing with cross-browser support. Use for: 1) Complex E2E test scenarios, 2) Multi-browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari), 3) Form automation (browser_fill_form), 4) Page verification (browser_snapshot for accessibility tree), 5) Parallel test execution. Prefer over curl for Next.js page verification. Auto-installs browsers if needed. Triggers: 'E2E test', 'test across browsers', 'automated testing', 'form testing', 'cross-browser', 'verify page', 'test Next.js'.

puppeteer.description: Lightweight browser automation for simple tasks. Use for: 1) Quick screenshots (puppeteer_screenshot), 2) PDF generation (puppeteer_pdf), 3) Simple web scraping (puppeteer_evaluate), 4) Single-browser automation. Lighter and faster than Playwright for simple tasks. Chrome-only. Triggers: 'screenshot', 'generate PDF', 'scrape webpage', 'simple automation', 'quick browser task'.

chrome-devtools.description: Performance analysis and detailed browser debugging. Use for: 1) Performance profiling (performance_start_trace for Core Web Vitals), 2) Network request analysis (list_network_requests), 3) Page diagnostics (take_snapshot for a11y tree), 4) Chrome-specific debugging, 5) Real-time debugging. Isolated mode for clean testing. Triggers: 'performance analysis', 'Core Web Vitals', 'network debugging', 'page performance', 'profiling', 'Chrome debugging'.

mcp-pandoc.description: Document format conversion with Pandoc. Use for: 1) Markdown to Word/PDF (requires TeX Live for PDF), 2) Word to Markdown, 3) Various format conversions (LaTeX, EPUB, RST), 4) Custom styling with reference_doc for DOCX, 5) Pandoc filters and defaults files. Bidirectional document conversion. Critical: Install TeX Live before PDF conversion. Triggers: 'convert document', 'markdown to PDF', 'Word to markdown', 'document conversion', 'export to PDF/Word'.

shadcn.description: shadcn/ui component management for React/Next.js. Use for: 1) Searching UI components (search_items_in_registries with fuzzy matching), 2) Getting usage examples (get_item_examples_from_registries with '-demo' or 'example' patterns), 3) Viewing component details (view_items_in_registries), 4) Getting add commands (get_add_command_for_items), 5) Quality checklist after adding (get_audit_checklist). Requires components.json in project root. Triggers: 'shadcn', 'UI component', 'add component', 'button', 'form', 'card', 'component example'.

docker.description: Docker container and Compose management. Use for: 1) Listing containers (list-containers), 2) Creating containers (create-container with image, name, ports, environment), 3) Deploying Compose stacks (deploy-compose with YAML), 4) Retrieving container logs (get-logs). For containerized projects and microservices. Triggers: 'Docker', 'container', 'docker-compose', 'containerize', 'microservice', 'container logs'.

terraform.description: Terraform documentation for multi-cloud IaC. Use for: 1) Searching Terraform modules (search_modules then get_module_details), 2) Provider documentation (search_providers then get_provider_details), 3) Policy documentation (search_policies then get_policy_details), 4) Latest versions (get_latest_module_version, get_latest_provider_version). Multi-cloud support (AWS, Azure, GCP). For AWS-specific, prefer awslabs MCPs. Triggers: 'Terraform', 'infrastructure as code', 'IaC', 'cloud resources', 'Terraform module', 'provider documentation'.

sequentialthinking.description: Complex problem-solving with dynamic thought process. Use for: 1) Breaking down complex multi-step problems, 2) Planning with room for revision, 3) Problems where scope is unclear initially, 4) Analysis needing course correction, 5) Generating and verifying solution hypotheses. Supports thought revision, branching, and adjustable thinking depth. Features: hypothesis generation/verification, thought revision, branching logic. Triggers: 'complex problem', 'break down task', 'plan implementation', 'unclear requirements', 'multi-step solution', 'analyze problem'.
